description: Leave comments on Markdown, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and HTML files beside the chat, then hand them all to an agent in one message. Select text, draw a box around a chart on a page or slide, pick spreadsheet cells, or click any element of an HTML page, and each comment keeps its exact place; a comment on an area reaches the agent with an image of that region. Draw over an HTML prototype or a page to cross out a button, circle a block, or point an arrow to where something should move; the agent gets a picture of the page as you saw it with your strokes on top and, on HTML, the elements each stroke touches. Send the drafts to the current chat or to a new one, and each comment shows whether the agent is on it, closed it with a note on what changed, or answered with a question. Zoom pages with a pinch, the wheel, or the zoom bar and they re-render sharp, so a large drawing reads up close; a landscape or wide page keeps the document's scale and scrolls sideways, and a long document loads only the pages on screen. Workbooks open as a formatted grid, HTML files as the live page with their own styles and scripts in a sandbox that keeps them away from bb, and the same tab works in bb's mobile web app. Needs poppler-utils and LibreOffice on the machine the bb server runs on; Chrome or Chromium there adds the pictures of drawings on HTML pages.
